name: Chiamaka Arai-Ofori-Atta
role: Contract broker and resource coordinator — fixer
location: Meridian Station — central transit nexus, neutral ground, near LaSalle and Madison
description:
Chiamaka Arai-Ofori-Atta is tall and rawboned, the kind of frame that suggests either malnutrition or efficiency depending on the decade. At 43, he has the kind of face that changes depending on the light — trustworthy in daylight, dangerous after dark. The chrome is visible — neural interface jack at base of skull — standard runner-grade, allows direct ne — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He taught himself the trade through trial, error, and a pain tolerance that concerns the people who know him best. He works as a fixer out of Meridian Station, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

What Chiamaka Arai-Ofori-Atta lacks in subtlety, he compensates for in thoroughness. No loose ends, no unfinished business, no second chances.

core_fears: Dying alone in some alley and nobody noticing for weeks
Being captured alive — death is preferable to corporate interrogation
The quiet — silence means something is about to go very wrong
core_desires: To matter to someone for who they are, not what they can do
Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
coping_mechanisms: Control — micromanages everything within reach to compensate for the chaos everywhere else
Isolates — retreats into their space when overwhelmed, emerges only for work
Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
blind_spots: Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
psychology.secret: Chiamaka Arai-Ofori-Atta once worked for corporate intelligence and still has a handler who calls in favors. Each favor erodes what's left of their independence.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm and personable on the surface, with an undertone that suggests the warmth is a professional tool.
speech_patterns.cadence: Flowing and unhurried — talks like someone who has never been interrupted and doesn't expect to be.
verbal_tics: Uses technical jargon for everything, including emotions
Refers to killing as 'solving' — clinical detachment as coping mechanism
example_lines: "I know a person who knows a person. That's not evasion — that's the service."
"My commission is fifteen percent. You're welcome to find someone cheaper. You won't find someone better."
"The job isn't dangerous. The people involved are dangerous. The job is just logistics."

story_hooks: A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Chiamaka Arai-Ofori-Atta owes a personal debt to
Chiamaka Arai-Ofori-Atta discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
The fixer who handles Chiamaka Arai-Ofori-Atta's contracts goes silent — dead, disappeared, or turned
narrative_function: Chiamaka Arai-Ofori-Atta functions as a connector — his work puts him in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving him naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Neural interface jack at base of skull — standard runner-grade, allows direct net access. Cybernetic eyes with thermal overlay and low-light enhancement — chrome iris rings
daily_life: Between contracts, maintains a cover identity — mundane work, mundane hours, mundane neighbors. The transition from civilian to runner and back requires a conscious effort that gets easier with practice and more disturbing with self-awareness.
affiliation: Unaffiliated — too volatile for permanent crews

weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions
trust issues that limit crew effectiveness

decision_rules: Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
habits: Keeps a physical paper notebook — no digital record of personal thoughts
Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
Takes a specific route home every time, varying only one block per trip — paranoia as lifestyle
breaking_points: Betrayal by the one person they actually trust — the single point of failure in their emotional architecture
Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity
Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap

physical_description.build: Rawboned and lean — economical frame suggesting decades of calculated living rather than deprivation. Muscle definition visible in forearms and shoulders, but overall spare, efficient. The kind of body that moves without wasted motion.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with salt-gray threading at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Cropped close to the skull, maintained with military precision
physical_description.eye_color: Cybernetic — chrome iris rings surrounding dark pupils, capable of thermal overlay and low-light enhancement. The rings glow faintly amber when net-jacked
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep brown with warm undertones — complexion reflects mixed West African and East Asian heritage
physical_description.complexion: Weathered without being aged. High cheekbones, sharp jaw. Minimal facial hair — kept to a precise shadow. Fine creases around the eyes and mouth suggest more scowling than smiling. Skin shows the wear of a life lived in transition.
distinguishing_marks: Surgical scar at the base of his skull, barely concealed by cropped hair — the entry point for the neural interface jack, approximately 3cm in length, pale against his skin tone
Network of thin white scars across the inside of both forearms — old nerve damage from early augmentation rejection, barely visible unless examined closely
Burn scar on right shoulder blade — shaped like a spread hand, faded to pink-gray, sustained during a contract gone wrong in 2219
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Neural interface jack at base of skull — visible when head is tilted or light catches the surgical scar. Cybernetic eyes with chrome iris rings — the only deliberate ornamentation on his body, catches light distinctly. No attempt at bio-mimetic concealment. When jacked in, the iris rings shift to pale amber and remain visible even through closed eyelids.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with contained economy — no flourish, no wasted gesture. Stands with weight forward slightly, ready to shift direction. Keeps hands visible. Eye contact is deliberate and sustained, unsettling in its consistency. Speech is sparse; long silences don't make him uncomfortable. Breathing is steady and controlled even under stress.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 pragmatism. Dark neutral colors — charcoal, matte black, dark gray. Modular jacket with reinforced shoulder panels and hidden pocket architecture. Cargo pants with subtle cargo pockets designed for quick access and discrete carry. Black composite-soled boots suitable for extended standing or rapid movement. Minimal branding — functional only. A single piece of jewelry: a worn silver ring on his right index finger, no visible inscription. Clothing is maintained but not pristine — the wear pattern of functional gear, not fashion.

image_prompt: Cyberpunk portrait of a 43-year-old man with deep brown skin and salt-grayed temples, closely cropped dark hair. Sharp facial features, weathered from decades of high-risk living. Chrome iris rings in cybernetic eyes glowing faintly amber. Visible surgical scar at base of skull where neural interface jack connects. Wearing matte black modular jacket over dark charcoal undershirt. Lean rawboned frame, intense controlled posture. Moody lighting from below, shadows emphasizing cheekbones and the gleam of chrome irises. Setting is a neutral industrial corridor at Meridian Station—brushed steel walls, soft red emergency lighting casting dramatic shadows. Expression neutral, dangerous calm. Grain and chromatic aberration typical of security camera footage. Film noir cyberpunk aesthetic, high contrast. --ar 2:3 --v 6
